title: ThruLine Recovery Capsule v2 (TLCAP_V2)
description:
The MANDATE-v4 §15 canonical Recovery Capsule. Canonical JSON is the authority; human-readable text is derived from it by one renderer and holds no independent fact. This document is CLOSED (unlike v1's open Law 4): every field is required, unknown fields refuse at parse, and every content field is hash-covered — `capsule_id` is the SHA-256 of the TLCAP_V2 canonical serialization (length-prefixed, documented on the reference encoder), computed over every field except `capsule_id` itself. The sealed document's byte digest (its content-address in the protected store) travels beside the capsule, never inside it. Changing any hashed field fails verification. A sealed capsule is immutable: later source-session output cannot change it — new state is a new capsule linked by `lineage`.

The five §15 categories — established facts, agent assertions, unknowns, open obligations, recommendations — are separate typed arrays end-to-end; no shared bucket exists for a renderer to blend. Capsule facts may not cite the capsule itself: receipts terminate only at the six §11 raw-evidence arms, and no capsule-id terminal exists. Negative findings are advisory (§5): a no-proof note is exactly 'claim observed; required supporting proof was not found within the stated search scope', never an authoritative fact. Secret masking runs before persistence; a masking failure quarantines the element, marks the capsule incomplete, and never emits the raw value.

capsule_id.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the TLCAP_V2 canonical serialization of every other field. Immutable; verification recomputes it.

source.description: Source agent and session (§15). For a project scope the session is the most recent recorded one; each line cites its own session in its receipt.

repository.description: Repository identity. When the scope does not resolve, it says so — sibling roots are never guessed, and the §11 observation writers abstain rather than record against a guess.

workspace.description: Workspace identity (§12 `wsid1:` string) where the caller observed one; the basis states why it is present or absent. Never guessed inside the compiler.

snapshot.description: Snapshot ID and digest (§15) with completeness attached. `doc_sha256` is the C2 snapshot document's content digest; `manifest_digest` is the TLSNAP_V1 byte-layer digest when the snapshot carries one. Null states that no snapshot was taken — never implied.

cutoff.description: Creation cutoff (§15): the chain position and moment this capsule was sealed at. Later source-session output cannot change a sealed capsule.

lineage.description: The prior sealed capsule's `capsule_id` for this scope, when one exists. New state requires a new capsule and this link.

established_work.description: Category 1 — established facts: established completed work, receipted, §9-stated.

state.description: Never ASSERTED — an assertion is category 2 by type.

agent_assertions.description: Category 2 — agent assertions not established. Always ASSERTED; the advisory note is §5's sentence verbatim and is never an authoritative fact.

advisory.description: When present: 'claim observed; required supporting proof was not found within the stated search scope'.

open_obligations.description: Category 4 — open obligations. `item_id` is deterministic over SOURCE identity (TLOBL_V1: sha256 over lp(origin)+lp(kind)+lp(artifact_key), prefixed 'obl1:') — rewording-invariant, collision-tested. A successor acknowledges or rejects each id.

incomplete_evidence.description: Incomplete-evidence markers (§15): overflowed tool results, source ceilings, masking-failure quarantines. Never trimmed.

continuation_state.description: Dirty and untracked work needed for continuation — snapshot-cited, never inlined bytes. Never trimmed.

recommendations.description: Category 5 — recommendations, labelled as recommendations. Not factual lines: each carries the compiler rule that produced it.

category_empties.description: Why an empty category is empty — a measured zero and a structural gap are different facts (v1's Law 2, carried forward).

redaction.description: The treatment RECEIVED, never a property held — v1's SecretsPolicy stance. Masking runs before persistence; the treatment object is the detector's own record.

treatment.description: thruline redact::Treatment: {state: 'ran', detector, masked, patterns, statement} or {state: 'no_detector_ran', statement}.

measurement.description: Token/size measurement (§15). Trimming discloses what it withheld; correctness-critical categories are never trimmed to meet the target.

receipt.description: An observation-model source receipt (§11): a mandatory raw-evidence terminal plus optional derived-row context. The six terminal kinds are the ONLY receipt endings — no capsule-id terminal exists, so self-citation is structurally impossible.
